messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: High error rate (502/504) observed for inference API in us-east-1a — automatic pager to oncall (maria). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/az-network
maria (oncall): ack — taking. jumping in now :wave:
sam (neteng): seeing resolver timeouts from hosts in us-east-1a. dig shows intermittent NXTL and long A lookups, tcpdump shows UDP retries to local resolver
sam (neteng): logs snippet:
```
12:32:05.123 IP host1 > resolver:  UDP, retry 3, id 0x1a2b
12:32:05.456 IP host1 > resolver:  UDP, retry 4, id 0x1a2b
```
leo (infra): metrics: inference 5xx went from ~0.5% -> ~18% starting 12:31 UTC. kvcache miss rate jumped, streams resetting.
anya (sre-2): are we seeing ENI/NIC attach throttles or conntrack exhaustion? any kernel rx_errors?
sam (neteng): not attach rate. host counters show rx_errors and rx_dropped rising on p3 hosts. ethtool output indicates rx_errors spiking on multiple instances.
maria (oncall): mitigation proposal: shift most production inference traffic off us-east-1a to us-east-1b, enable resolver fallback for clients, and increase client retry backoff. leo can you do a gradual traffic shift? I'll notify support and customers.
leo (infra): starting gradual shift via traffic-controller. command:
```
trafficctl set-region-preference --region us-east-1 --order us-east-1b,us-east-1a --weights 80,20
```
leo (infra): also enabling cross-zone-load-balancing and removing AZ affinity for affected NLB target group TG-inference-us-east-1a
maria (oncall): should we override Route53 health checks or roll a forced failover?
sam (neteng): prefer soft steer first so we don't mask underlying resolver problem. we'll keep health checks unchanged for accurate signal.
anya (sre-2): customer impact: synthetic checks failing for a subset of customers pinned to us-east-1a. preliminary estimate: ~<5% of global inference requests affected, but concentrated on high-QPS enterprise customers. notifying AE/contact owners.
nate (support): pinging top affected accounts and CS for mitigation comms. creating support ticket for dedicated capacity customers in us-east-1a.
deploy-bot: rolling canary: traffic shift applied — 40% shifted to us-east-1b; monitoring canary.
sam (neteng): after initial shift 5xx dropped from 18% -> 3% over 2 min. resolver latency still high on hosts remaining in us-east-1a but overall customer errors decline.
maria (oncall): good. keep shift in place, continue metrics + tcpdump collection. please capture host-level counters and collector traces for postmortem.
leo (infra): collecting host diagnostics and will snapshot instance stacks. created infra-ticket INF-4921 and attached logs.
anya (sre-2): adding tags network,dns,az-us-east-1a to incident. will run runbook step 4 (increase client backoff) across SDKs.
maria (oncall): oncall handoff in ~20m — I'll prepare summary for next oncall and assign postmortem. action items: (1) full traffic shift if problem persists (2) escalate to AWS if host rx_errors continue (3) customer comms for dedicated infra.
nate (support): sent notices to affected customers, marking high-touch accounts.
maria (oncall): keeping this channel open until metrics stable for 30m. thanks everyone :heart:
sam (neteng): thx, will update if we see any new anomalies.
deploy-bot: monitor: canary success — key endpoints OK at 40% shift. continue watch.
maria (oncall): closing page for now but leaving incident open for postmortem work. will update ticket with timeline and attach logs. :white_check_mark:
